name: Quiet Minimalism
tagline: Calm, spacious and typographic: seriousness through restraint
idea: A quiet, book-like website where typography carries the work: generous margins, fine rules and a large serif headline; stories as numbered lists, impact told in one sentence, and images used sparingly, so every word carries weight.
fit: Restraint signals seriousness. For an organisation whose credibility rests on careful evidence and dignified testimony, a calm, reading-first site lets the research and the families’ words speak without visual noise.
informedBy: Hierarchy from scale, spacing and fine rules.
A dated, typed list of the latest stories.
Participation placed at one meaningful point.
distinct: Built mostly from type and space: a headline that runs the width of the page, numbered lists instead of cards, one Menu button, and impact told in one sentence.
buttons: Square charcoal buttons, hairline outlines, moss underlined links and bordered tags; no rounded corners.
imageDirection: Two or three images per page, desaturated and soft, never full-bleed, with generous margins and thin captions.
navigation: Wordmark, Search, one Menu button and an underlined Donate link; mobile keeps only Menu and Donate.
visualCharacter: Calm, bookish, typographic; bone paper, fine rules, moss accents
contentEmphasis: Reading first: the lead feature, numbered latest list, research
bestFor: An organisation that wants to be read and trusted, with a calm, credible, long-lasting presence.
tradeoffs: Less urgent: Donate is a quiet text link, one Menu button hides the sections, and sparse imagery can feel reserved.
